PlayerProgress.title: PlayerProgress
PlayerProgress.description: Tracks the authenticated player's current level, highest unlocked level, total stars, moves, and favorite collectible companion.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this progress record.

currentLevel.description: The level number the player is currently playing (1-999).

highestUnlockedLevel.description: The highest level number unlocked by the player (1-999).

completedLevelsCount.description: Total count of distinct completed levels.

totalStars.description: Total stars earned across completed levels.

totalMoves.description: Cumulative moves made across completed levels.

selectedCompanionId.description: Optional ID of the unlocked collectible figure selected as the player's mascot.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() upon initial creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on every update.

UnlockedFigure.title: UnlockedFigure
UnlockedFigure.description: Represents a collectible figure unlocked by completing a specific level, along with best performance stats.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this collectible.

figureId.description: Unique identifier matching the document ID of the collectible figure.

unlockedAtLevel.description: The level number that unlocked this collectible figure (1-999).

starsEarned.description: Best star rating earned for this level (1-3).

bestMoves.description: Lowest number of moves taken to solve this level (1-999).

timesCompleted.description: Number of times the player completed this level.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() when first unlocked.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() when updated.

/users/{userId}/progress/{progressId}.description: User-isolated document storing current level and overall game progress (document ID: main).

/users/{userId}/unlockedFigures/{figureI.description: User-isolated subcollection of unlocked collectible figures earned by completing levels.
